benchmarks.question: How many orders were placed in August 2026?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f JOIN hop.analytics.dim_date d ON f.placed_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.month_start = DATE'2026-08-01'

benchmarks.question: What is the cancellation rate in each city?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT z.city, round(count_if(f.status = 'cancelled') / count(*), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f JOIN hop.analytics.dim_zone z ON f.zone_sk = z.zone_sk GROUP BY z.city

benchmarks.question: What share of delivered Instant orders were late?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT round(count_if(f.minutes_past_promise > 5) / count(*), 4) AS late_share FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f WHERE f.status = 'delivered' AND f.delivery_class = 'instant'

benchmarks.question: What share of delivered Standard orders were late?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT round(count_if(f.minutes_past_promise > 20) / count(*), 4) AS late_share FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f WHERE f.status = 'delivered' AND f.delivery_class = 'standard'

benchmarks.question: What is the average delivery time in minutes of delivered orders for each delivery class?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT f.delivery_class, round(avg(f.actual_minutes), 2) AS avg_delivery_minutes FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f WHERE f.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY f.delivery_class

benchmarks.question: Which restaurant (restaurant_id) had the most delivered orders?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT r.restaurant_id, count(*) AS delivered_orders FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f JOIN hop.analytics.dim_restaurant r ON f.restaurant_sk = r.restaurant_sk WHERE f.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.restaurant_id ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC, r.restaurant_id LIMIT 1

benchmarks.question: What was the total value of delivered orders for each customer tier?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.tier, round(sum(f.order_value), 2) AS delivered_value FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f JOIN hop.analytics.dim_customer c ON f.customer_sk = c.customer_sk WHERE f.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.tier

benchmarks.question: How many delivered orders went to each zone type in July 2026?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT z.zone_type, count(*) AS delivered_orders FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f JOIN hop.analytics.dim_zone z ON f.zone_sk = z.zone_sk JOIN hop.analytics.dim_date d ON f.placed_date_key = d.date_key WHERE f.status = 'delivered' AND d.month_start = DATE'2026-07-01' GROUP BY z.zone_type

benchmarks.question: What is the late rate of delivered orders in each city?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT z.city, round(count_if(f.status = 'delivered' AND f.minutes_past_promise > CASE WHEN f.delivery_class = 'instant' THEN 5 ELSE 20 END) / count_if(f.status = 'delivered'), 4) AS late_rate FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f JOIN hop.analytics.dim_zone z ON f.zone_sk = z.zone_sk GROUP BY z.city

benchmarks.question: How many hop_pro customers placed at least one order?
benchmarks.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers FROM hop.analytics.fact_orders f JOIN hop.analytics.dim_customer c ON f.customer_sk = c.customer_sk WHERE c.tier = 'hop_pro'
